description: This file contains functions for handling and identifying specific context window errors from various AI providers, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Cerebras, and OpenRouter. It exports a main function to check if an error is a context window exceeded error, and internal functions to identify errors from different providers based on error structure and messages.

methods.name: checkContextWindowExceededError
methods.description: Main exported function that checks if an error is a context window exceeded error by delegating to provider-specific checks.

methods.name: checkIsOpenRouterContextWindowError
methods.description: Checks if an error matches known patterns for OpenRouter context window errors.

methods.name: checkIsOpenAIContextWindowError
methods.description: Checks if an error matches known patterns for OpenAI context window errors.

methods.name: checkIsAnthropicContextWindowError
methods.description: Checks if a response matches patterns for Anthropic context window errors.

methods.name: checkIsCerebrasContextWindowError
methods.description: Checks if a response matches patterns for Cerebras context window errors.
